title: Synthetic Data Generator in Data Scarce Environments
summary: Research code accompanying a paper on generating synthetic tabular data in low-sample/data-scarce settings, comparing a proposed generator against state-of-the-art deep generative baselines on benchmark datasets (adult, intrusion, king, news). SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) are run as SOTA baseline models against which the paper's own method is evaluated.
evidence: gen_model/data_generation/main_gen_sota.py:17-36 imports CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and trains them as SOTA comparison models
